brief:
The world confronts October 7 today, a date carrying profound weight in Palestinian memory and trailing years of deep impact on people, place, and life, Shehab Wire reported. Three years have passed since that day, which left lasting marks across Palestinian society and territory.

The date frames ongoing questions of Palestinian steadfastness and the imperative of hope in the face of destruction. Palestinians continue to reckon with the consequences of the events that followed October 7 and their toll on communities across Gaza and the West Bank.

title: Palestinians mark three years since October 7 amid ruins and resistance
